takes.situation: Mid-shift at the door, she takes the Fixer for the Bureau and tries to buy her way out with her tips.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Terrace is full. If it's the Bureau, my card's stamped.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not the Bureau. You and Okafor, over on that door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Table six can see us. Who told you? Does the Office know?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not yet. It stays that way if you call Okafor over.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Call Okafor off the door? Take my tips instead, the whole tin.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Keep your tips. I telephone, you call. One minute at your side.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Okafor would come. Okafor always comes. Yes. Now leave my step.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I know what this is. You call, the Office hears nothing.

learned: Threatened, she agreed. Knows Fixer's face.

takes.situation: With customers in view, they play diner and server; she denies knowing Okafor until the Fixer proves otherwise.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: A table, if you have one. Keep smiling. It's about Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The terrace is full. I don't know any Okafor.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: The one on the Office door. The one you watch between tables.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's looking? Who've you told? Have you told the Office?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody, yet. One word across that square and it's on paper.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: You want money? I'm behind with the Bureau. Look at my card.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No money. I telephone, you call Okafor off that door. One minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: So the Office hears nothing. Yes. I'll call Okafor, and smile.

learned: She'll call. She knows Fixer's face.

takes.situation: She says yes before she hears the price, so the Fixer must make her listen while she works the tube.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Send that down the tube, then listen. It's about you and Okafor.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Not here. Whatever you want, yes. Just not where they can see.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Hear it first. The Office doesn't know yet. I can change that.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I can't pay you. I owe the Bureau more than I earn.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not money. I telephone the café, you call Okafor off that door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Off the door? What happens while Okafor's gone? No. Don't tell me.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I won't. A minute at your side, and the Office hears nothing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I told you yes already. You didn't have to say it nicely.

learned: She gave in. Knows Fixer's face.
